name: SkyPilot Catalog Azure GPU instances extract - ND series with per-hour rates
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Extracted GPU instance rows from the SkyPilot Azure v8 catalog. Key GPU instance types: Standard_NV36adms_A10_v5 (1x A10, $4.52/hr on-demand eastus, $1.13 spot); Standard_NV36ads_A10_v5 (1x A10, $3.20/hr); Standard_NV72ads_A10_v5 (2x A10, $6.52/hr); Standard_NV48s_v3 (4x M60, $4.56/hr); Standard_NV32as_v4 (1x Radeon MI25, $2.237/hr). Azure's GPU catalog in SkyPilot is limited - the ND H100 v5 and ND H200 v5 series are NOT in the SkyPilot catalog, likely because they are only available through special allocation or the catalog fetcher doesn't cover them. The existing repo records (azure-nd-h100-v5, azure-nd-h200-v5) were sourced from the Azure Retail Prices API directly. Azure spot discounts are very deep (70-80% in some cases). All prices per instance-hour.
